senses.gloss: m. (כתת, with inserted נ, cmp. כּוּנְשְׁרָא) [that which is pounded,] spelt.
units: M. Kat. 13ᵇ כי … אמר כ׳ when Rab Dimi came (to Babylonia) he defined ḥelka (v. חֶילְקָא II) as kunta.—Pl. כּוּנְתַּיָּא, (כּוּנָּתַיָּא) כּוּנְתִּין.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 9:32">Targ. Ex. IX, 32</cite> <he>כּוּנָּ׳</he> ed. Berl. (ed. Amst. <cite ref="K00299"><he>כּוּנָ׳</he></cite>; Y. <cite ref="K00313"><he>כּוּנְתַּ׳</he></cite>, Var. <he>כָּנְתַּ׳</he>, <he>כֻּנְתַּ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 28:25">Targ. Is. XXVIII, 25</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 4:9">Targ. Ez. IV, 9</cite> (ed. Wil. <he>כּוּנְתִין</he>, oth. ed. <he>כונתּ׳</he>).
